1: // Minimal Asteroid Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas element #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   const keys = {};
11:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
12:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
13: 
14:   class Ship {
15:     constructor() {
16:       this.x = canvas.width / 2;
17:       this.y = canvas.height / 2;
18:       this.angle = 0; // radians
19:       this.radius = 10;
20:     }
21:     update(dt) {
22:       // rotation
23:       if (keys['ArrowLeft']) this.angle -= 3 * dt;
24:       if (keys['ArrowRight']) this.angle += 3 * dt;
25:       // thrust
26:       const thrust = 200; // pixels per second squared
27:       if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
28:         this.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * thrust * dt;
29:         this.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * thrust * dt;
30:       }
31:       // keep within bounds (wrap around)
32:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += canvas.width;
33:       if (this.x > canvas.width) this.x -= canvas.width;
34:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += canvas.height;
35:       if (this.y > canvas.height) this.y -= canvas.height;
36:     }
37:     draw() {
38:       ctx.save();
39:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
40:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
41:       ctx.beginPath();
42:       ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
43:       ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
44:       ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
45:       ctx.closePath();
46:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
47:       ctx.fill();
48:       ctx.restore();
49:     }
50:   }
51: 
52:   class Asteroid {
53:     constructor() {
54:       // spawn at random edge
55:       const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
56:       if (edge === 0) { this.x = 0; this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height; }
57:       else if (edge === 1) { this.x = canvas.width; this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height; }
58:       else if (edge === 2) { this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; this.y = 0; }
59:       else { this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; this.y = canvas.height; }
60:       const speed = 50 + Math.random() * 100;
61:       const dir = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
62:       this.vx = Math.cos(dir) * speed;
63:       this.vy = Math.sin(dir) * speed;
64:       this.radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
65:     }
66:     update(dt) {
67:       this.x += this.vx * dt;
68:       this.y += this.vy * dt;
69:       // wrap
70:       if (this.x < -this.radius) this.x = canvas.width + this.radius;
71:       if (this.x > canvas.width + this.radius) this.x = -this.radius;
72:       if (this.y < -this.radius) this.y = canvas.height + this.radius;
73:       if (this.y > canvas.height + this.radius) this.y = -this.radius;
74:     }
75:     draw() {
76:       ctx.beginPath();
77:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
78:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'gray';
79:       ctx.stroke();
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   const ship = new Ship();
84:   const asteroids = [];
85:   let lastTime = performance.now();
86:   let spawnTimer = 0;
87:   let survived = 0;
88:   let gameOver = false;
89: 
90:   function spawnAsteroid() {
91:     asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
92:   }
93: 
94:   function checkCollision() {
95:     for (const a of asteroids) {
96:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
97:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
98:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
99:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) return true;
100:     }
101:     return false;
102:   }
103: 
104:   function loop(now) {
105:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
106:     lastTime = now;
107:     if (!gameOver) {
108:       survived += dt;
109:       // spawn every 1.5 seconds
110:       spawnTimer += dt;
111:       if (spawnTimer > 1.5) { spawnTimer = 0; spawnAsteroid(); }
112:       ship.update(dt);
113:       for (const a of asteroids) a.update(dt);
114:       if (checkCollision()) gameOver = true;
115:     }
116:     // render
117:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
118:     ship.draw();
119:     for (const a of asteroids) a.draw();
120:     // UI
121:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
122:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
123:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${survived.toFixed(2)}s`, 10, 20);
124:     if (gameOver) {
125:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
126:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
127:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
128:     }
129:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
130:   }
131: 
132:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
133: })();
